item.title: Pepperdine College Democrats Hosts Renée Good Vigil
item.description: Pepperdine College Democrats hosted a vigil honoring the life of Renée Good in the Amphitheatre on Jan. 22. Several students spoke about the politics that led to the fatal shooting of Good by a U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer in Minneapolis two weeks prior. The post Pepperdine College Democrats Hosts Renée Good Vigil appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Opinion: Connection is Not as Real as We Think
item.description: In the age of iPhones and social media, this generation is often considered more connected than ever. Perspectives Staff Writer Eva Shauriki argues being hyper-connected online is detrimental to true human relationships and bonds, and we are not as connected as we may think. The post Opinion: Connection is Not as Real as We Think appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: ‘Italian at Heart’: Screen Arts and Italian Studies Student Blends Multicultural Values into Filmmaking
item.description: A lifelong love of Italian culture and a desire for a career in the entertainment industry have shaped senior Alekza Rhyan's path. As she looks toward graduation, she is turning away from LA and chasing her dreams to international lengths. The post ‘Italian at Heart’: Screen Arts and Italian Studies Student Blends Multicultural Values into Filmmaking appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Opinion: Create Dopamine Instead Of Chasing It
item.description: College doesn’t stop being fun because something's going wrong — it stops being fun because the human brain adapts. Perspectives Staff Writer Hana Wadlow explores how habituation, anticipation and mindset shape happiness and how students can intentionally bring excitement back into everyday college life. The post Opinion: Create Dopamine Instead Of Chasing It appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Staff Editorial: Participate in Community Building
item.description: Many students struggle to find or participate in community while in college. The Graphic writes why students should participate in community building through Intercultural Affairs clubs. item.title: Weisman Museum Presents Their New Exhibition: ‘A Modern Look’
item.description: The Frederick R. Weisman Museum of Art opened their new exhibit, titled 'A Modern Look,' Jan. 16. The exhibit features selections from the museum's permanent collection and will run through Sunday, March 29. The post Weisman Museum Presents Their New Exhibition: ‘A Modern Look’ appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Opinion: Pepperdine’s Malibu Location Negatively Impacts Students
item.description: Pepperdine’s location in Malibu impacts students in several ways. Perspectives Staff Writer Alyssa Hunnicutt argues the Malibu location negatively impacts students through decreased campus activity and limits to getting off-campus. The post Opinion: Pepperdine’s Malibu Location Negatively Impacts Students appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Democrat and Republican Clubs Start Semester with Community and Conversation
item.description: Pepperdine’s College Democrats and College Republicans chapters began the semester focusing on political dialogue and civic duty. item.title: Rave: Why Pepperdine Needs a Football Team
item.description: One of the strongest symbols of school spirit at a university is its football team. Pepperdine should bring football back to Malibu. The post Rave: Why Pepperdine Needs a Football Team appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Rant: Having a Football Team is Pointless
item.description: A hot topic that is usually on students' minds is why does Pepperdine not have a football team? However, there is no need for a Waves football team. The post Rant: Having a Football Team is Pointless appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.
